name: Song Cau grilled chicken
summary: Chicken cut into wings and thighs, marinated with onion, pepper, chilli, garlic, and fish sauce, then grilled over charcoal. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note says no fewer than five salts come with it, and names four. The same note says Tổ chức Kỷ lục Việt Nam put it in a Top 100. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Sông Cầu, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note.
howToEat: Cut the bird wing by wing and thigh by thigh, marinate it with onion, pepper, chilli, garlic, and fish sauce, and grill it over charcoal. The note says the cut is what lets the meat take the marinade.

The salts are no fewer than five. The note names muối tiêu vắt chanh, muối ớt giã lá chanh, muối ớt xanh giã nhuyễn, and muối ớt đỏ. A fifth salt is not named. A street inside Sông Cầu was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Sông Cầu. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Song Cau grilled chicken — five salts, four of them named
seoDescription: Chicken grilled over charcoal in Song Cau, with no fewer than five salts. Four are named. A street and a price are Check on arrival.
